name: brand.list
description: The brands the caller reaches, in the switcher's order: every brand of every company they are a member of, company by company (by name), each company's in its own order.
sql: select (brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(b)) || jsonb_build_object('createdAt', brandbase.iso(b.created_at))) as result from brandbase.brands b join brandbase.organizations o on o.id = b.org_id order by o.name, o.id, b.position, b.id
